narrative.northStar: The cost sheet on the estimator's desk
narrative.overview: A manufacturing cost tool in soft slate: dim grey ground, off-white text, muted accents. One primary user and one task per screen; a grouped left sidebar; the margin-floor bar as the one signature chart; colour that means one thing each. The full brief is docs/redesign/REDESIGN.md.
keyCharacteristics: Grouped 230px left sidebar with Home on top; demo controls in a drawer.
Three meaning colours: blue clickable, terracotta below floor or money lost, amber needs a person.
Margin-floor bar in three places only.
Inter for text, Archivo Narrow 600 for display figures.
Sentence case; no uppercase labels, pill badges or middle-dot strings.

rules.name: One Job Per Colour
rules.body: Blue means clickable and nothing else. Terracotta is below floor and money lost. Amber is needs a person. Good or neutral results are plain text.

rules.name: One Filled Button
rules.body: Each screen has exactly one filled button; everything else is an outline.

rules.name: Numbers Or The Bar
rules.body: A margin is shown as numbers or as the margin-floor bar, never both in the same area.

rules.name: Say It Once
rules.body: A column with the same value on every visible row is hidden and stated once above the table.

rules.name: Count It The Same Way
rules.body: The same thing is counted the same way on every page.

rules.name: Plain Names
rules.body: No internal ids or builder's column names in what people read.

dos: **Do** keep it dark only, in the slate palette.
**Do** use blue only for what can be clicked.
**Do** keep one filled button per screen.
**Do** collapse rows with nothing to act on behind 'Show {n} unaffected'.
donts: **Don't** bring back the green band, uppercase stencil labels, pill badges, material colour squares or middle-dot strings.
**Don't** put the margin-floor bar in list rows.
**Don't** use blue for status words, percentages or amounts.
**Don't** put demo controls in the working layout.
